universal_lens: Temporal kinematic windows for brain strain estimation in football impacts via finite element modeling. Temporal kernel convolution of kinematic history defines 95% MPS/MPSR peak accuracy; brain geometry modulates required pre-trigger duration.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference on head impact kinematics using Stanford mouthguard data to estimate mild TBI risk through strain rate and principal strain metrics. Bayesian inference maps 95% MPS/MPSR peaks to posterior distributions over head model parameters using kernel density estimates and εcrit thresholds.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning engine maps real-time head kinematic data to state transitions in brain strain models for predictive injury assessment. Situational reasoning encodes state transitions from impact onset to peak kinematics via time-range constraints and multi-spike event detection.

primitives.name: Time Window for Brain Strain Calculation
primitives.verbatim_quote: To find a time window that can provide a sufficient duration of kinematics for FE analysis, we investigated 118 on-field video-confirmed head impacts collected by the Stanford Instrumented Mouthguard.
primitives.assumptions: Head kinematics are captured with sufficient temporal resolution; finite element models require minimal duration for accurate strain calculation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: T_w < 0.001 s leads to insufficient data for strain computation; T_w > 0.05 s may include irrelevant post-impact motion.

layer2.mapping: Maps temporal kinematic data to brain strain estimates via FE simulation; enables GSI probabilistic risk inference.
layer2.telemetry: 95th percentile maximal principal strain (MPS) and strain rate (MPSR) from FE simulations

primitives.name: Finite Element Brain Model Simulation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Then, based on the collected kinematics, finite element (FE) head models can calculate brain strain, which is used to evaluate the risk of mild traumatic brain injury.

primitives.assumptions: Brain is modeled as isotropic linear elastic material; FE mesh resolution is sufficient for strain localization.
primitives.breakdown_regime: V_{brain} < 1e-6 m³ or E_{brain} > 1e9 Pa invalidates model assumptions.
